facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Peter looked around. He saw a big basket. He went under it. He hid under a basket.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Peter was still stuck inside the garden. He needed a safe place to hide from Mr. McGregor. He spotted a large basket near the flower pots. He hid under a basket and held his breath. Mr. McGregor walked right past him. Peter stayed very still until the footsteps were gone.
facts.Word cards: hid = 숨었다 / under = 아래에 / pot = 화분 / trembling = 떨리는
